propositions: Accepted /rerun and recheck-review requests enqueued only as in-memory _rebar_force events disappear if the process exits before dequeuing, leaving Gerrit vote and stale SQLite dedup unchanged so reconciliation skips the revision

The durable fix resets the exact revision to neutral LLM-Review:0 before acknowledgement; the resulting Gerrit comment-added event with patchSet fields is the durable marker re-admitting the revision to reconciliation after process loss
Reconciliation must query Gerrit before consulting local dedup; a confirmed no-nonzero-vote state permits clearing only the exact stale voted row and proceeding to review
The fixed-neutral reset is invoked only after eligibility succeeds and accepts only neutral value 0; contributor text cannot choose label values or mint PASS/BLOCK, preserving the security invariant
Reset, verify, budget-reset, and forced-event operations must complete atomically before HTTP acceptance; reset or verification failure returns non-success with no queued event and no acknowledgement

A held-out test proves the complete restart path: old nonzero vote plus stale dedup with exhausted budget survives process loss; one reconcile pass consumes the reset-emitted event and casts exactly one new vote
